unit.why: A brief eyewitness memorate: the author saw R. Aharon of Zhitomir stand at dawn, cry out over the renewal of day and fill with fear and trembling, followed by a saying of his; it sits inside a numbered homiletic compilation on morning rising.
unit.boundary_note: item ד in a series of quoted teachings on morning rising; the frame is homiletic

stories.start_quote: כמו שראיתי מהרה״ק ר׳ אהרן מזיטאמיר
stories.summary_en: The narrator saw R. Aharon of Zhitomir standing in his room at dawn, crying out in wonder that night had just turned into day by God's doing, and filling with fear and trembling; R. Aharon taught that every creature should feel shame before the Creator and be stirred by the constant renewal of creation.
